_comment: Venue config for scripts/find-threads.mjs. Tier 1 = situation subs where arguers live (unbranded comments, never link). Tier 2 = personality home turf (organic discussion posts allowed). Tier 3 = founder subs, deprioritized on purpose: they evaluate products, they do not argue about situations.

venues.notes: 24.5M members. Verdict splits ARE the format. Judgement-bot sub: top-level comments must contain a verdict acronym (NTA/YTA/ESH/NAH/INFO) or they get removed. Lead with the verdict, then the nine-takes read.
Purest interpretive-disagreement sub on Reddit. The entire premise is 'two people read this differently'. Best single venue for the 9takes move.
Looser AITA spinoff, no verdict-format requirement. Good for longer reads.
High volume, high emotion. Skew toward threads where commenters split rather than pile on.
Smaller, less pile-on culture, comments get read. Good ratio of effort to visibility.
Smaller and more engaged. Check current gender-participation rules before commenting.
173k members. Home turf and the venue for the Monday Nine question. reddit/01-enneagram-organic-discussion.md is already written for this sub and is link-free by design. Flair: Type Discussion.
Much larger than r/Enneagram and openly curious about other systems. The MBTI-bridge angle already exists in docs/twitter/content-ideas/mbti-bridge.md.
Small, high signal, tolerant of system-comparison posts.
DEPRIORITIZED. reddit/04-sideproject-weekly-thread.md targets this. Founders evaluate products here; they do not leave takes. Keep on ice until the Nine loop is proven.
